basics.name: Haizhou Yu
basics.label: Technical Support Engineer at Streamax · M.Eng. Computer Engineering, University of Virginia
basics.summary: I am a computer engineer specializing in embedded systems, vehicle software and autonomous racing, with a B.S. and M.Eng. in Computer Engineering from the University of Virginia. I bring experience across the automotive, robotics and aerospace industries, and I like combining computer systems with those fields to build innovative products. I am also an independent music producer and build my own audio plugins.

work.name: Streamax America LLC
work.summary:
- Perform on-site quality control and functional validation of recorders, identifying abnormal product and escalating technical issues.
- Troubleshoot product hardware, software and system-level behavior while building working knowledge of MDVR architecture, vehicle integration and CAN-based functionality.
- Developed a Chrome extension for dashcam onboarding that gives contextual guidance and configuration instructions inside the device's local web interface.
highlights: MDVR, CAN, Vehicle Integration, Chrome Extensions

work.name: Cavalier Autonomous Racing
work.position: Vehicle Dynamics and Control Engineer, Motion Planning Engineer
work.summary:
- Developed new vehicle tire dynamics models (tire slip, traction limits) from telemetry recorded over 10+ laps to improve simulation fidelity.
- Responsible for simulation development; implemented an MCAP overlay player to overlay recorded data on simulation data.
- Developed Python tools for GGV diagram generation and raceline speed optimization to support autonomous racing simulation.
- Took part in 14 days of testing at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca, collecting telemetry and validating vehicle control models.
highlights: Vehicle Dynamics, Simulation, Motion Planning, Python

work.name: PACCAR Inc
work.summary:
- Automated diagnostic report downloads with Python Selenium, cutting manual collection effort by about 80%.
- Helped build a sprint analysis dashboard using Power BI and DevOps data, improving team efficiency and feedback.
- Developed a SQL + Power BI pipeline analyzing CAN DTC data for 10,000+ vehicles, improving diagnostic reporting and failure analysis.
- Programmed the manufacturing sequence for a new vehicle architecture and moved the system to a new data model, improving efficiency by 50%.
- Implemented features and resolved defects in the DAVIE4 diagnostic software, improving reliability with the next-generation vehicle architecture.
- Worked in an agile SDLC, taking part in Scrum, triage and other team meetings.
highlights: Python, SQL, Power BI, CAN, Agile SDLC
